newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank Gov Masar sees credit rates rising.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank Gov Masar sees credit rates rising.

text.p: National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) Governor Vladimir Masar said on Wednesday that he expects local banks to raise credit rates in the coming months, following the recent rise of interbank money market rates.
Speaking at a news conference, Masar said that while interbank rates have risen from end 1996 levels, few banks have increased credit prices for its corporate and retail clients.

"It is possible to expect that interest rates on (these loans) loans will increase by 1-2 percentage points...based on the preliminary figures for January and planned interest rates for March," he said.
He added that the average credit rate in December was 13.45 percent.
